description: Authors and caches a personalized container environment from a Dockerfile- like spec, as a single layer or as a composition of independently cached layers. Use when the user mentions "container layer", "Containerfile", "custom container", "cache my installs", "composable layers", "uv shim", or wants package installations, skills and environment config to survive an ephemeral session. Also for snapshotting, restoring or rebuilding that environment, and for capturing ad-hoc installs into a reproducible spec.
